start_hour_local_by_country.definition: Median local start hour and the share of campaigns started inside working hours, by organizer country. starts_at is assumed UTC and shifted by one representative offset per country, no DST, so multi-zone countries (US, Canada, Brazil, Australia) carry up to three hours of error.

weekend_start_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns starting on a local Saturday or Sunday, and on a local Monday, by organizer country. Same single-offset timezone caveat.

start_month_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns starting in each quarter and in November plus December, by organizer country, with the modal month. Month is taken from the local start time.

duration_by_country.definition: Median run length in days from the dataset's duration_in_days, with the share of very short and very long runs, by organizer country. duration_in_days disagrees with the date span on about one campaign in seven, so treat it as a band not a day count.

duration_by_industry.definition: Median run length in days by organizer industry, all countries, with the share of runs of a week or less.

governing_law_mismatch_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns whose generated terms name a governing law country other than the organizer's own IP country, by organizer country. Organizer country comes from IP, so a genuinely foreign-registered entity reads as a mismatch.

age_wording_in_custom_terms_by_country.definition: Among campaigns carrying custom terms text, the share whose terms name a minimum entry age and which threshold, by organizer country. Regex over the custom terms body only; campaigns on Gleam's generated terms are out of scope.

eligibility_wording_in_custom_terms_by_c.definition: Among campaigns carrying custom terms text, the share using the classic US sweepstakes formulas and the share naming a residency restriction, by organizer country.

wallet_action_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns asking for a wallet address, the crypto marker, by organizer country, with how those campaigns differ on size and duration.

question_action_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns running a question action, the share of those that turn on answer validation, and how often the word cap is moved off its default of 50, by organizer country. A validated or word-capped question is the closest thing in the data to a skill gate.

question_action_by_industry.definition: Share of campaigns running a question action and, among those, the share turning on answer validation, by organizer industry.

paid_and_secret_code_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns with at least one paid entry action and with a secret code action, by organizer country. Secret code is the offline or broadcast tie-in marker.

share_action_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns offering the referral share action, and among those, median viral share clicks per contestant, by organizer country. Share clicks are the raw click count, not confirmed referrals.

share_action_by_industry.definition: Share of campaigns offering the referral share action and median viral share clicks per contestant, by organizer industry.

worth_settings_by_country.definition: How organizers weight actions, by organizer country: median highest worth on the campaign, the share of actions worth more than one entry, and the share of campaigns using any variable-worth action.

mandatory_actions_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns making at least one action mandatory, and the median number of mandatory actions among those, by organizer country.

prize_structure_by_country.definition: Prize count and pool by organizer country: median prize rows, median total units given away, share of single-winner campaigns, and median stated pool in USD among campaigns that state a value.

prize_structure_by_industry.definition: Prize count and stated pool by organizer industry.

prize_currency_localisation_by_country.definition: Among campaigns that state a prize currency, how often the currency is the organizer country's own rather than USD, by organizer country. Rows with a null currency are excluded, not inferred, so this measures what organizers leave in the currency field, not what the prize is really worth.

local_language_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns whose widget language is English and the share set to a main language of the organizer country, by organizer country. Language lists are a hand mapping of the country's main languages, so a country with several gets credit for any of them.

email_optin_checkbox_by_country.definition: Among campaigns running an email subscribe action, the share whose opt-in checkbox setting is On or Auto rather than Off, and the share wired to an email provider integration, by organizer country. Auto shows the checkbox only where local law needs it.

email_optin_checkbox_by_industry.definition: Among campaigns running an email subscribe action, the share whose opt-in checkbox setting is On or Auto, and the share wired to a provider, by organizer industry.

invalid_entry_share_by_country.definition: Invalid entries as a share of all entries, by organizer country: the median campaign's rate and the share of campaigns above five and twenty per cent. Reported as a property of the entry stream, no judgement about cause. Six per cent of campaigns carry a null invalid_entries and are excluded.

invalid_entry_share_by_industry.definition: Invalid entries as a share of all entries, by organizer industry. Reported without judgement about cause.

impressions_per_contestant_by_country.definition: Median impressions per contestant and the implied conversion rate, by organizer country. Impressions count widget loads, so repeat visits by the same person inflate the denominator of the conversion rate.

repeat_organizer_by_country.definition: How much of each country's campaign volume comes from organizers who run repeatedly: the share of campaigns that are not the organizer's first on the dataset, the median campaigns per organizer, and the share that are an organizer's eleventh or later.

plan_tier_by_country.definition: Plan tier mix by organizer country: the share on each of the paid tiers.

landing_kind_by_country.definition: Where a country's giveaway impressions land: the share on a Gleam-hosted page, on the Gleam directory listing, and on the organizer's own site as an embed, by organizer country. Impression-weighted, so a handful of very large campaigns can move a country.

referrer_mix_by_country.definition: Where a country's giveaway traffic comes from, as a share of impressions by referrer channel, by organizer country. Direct covers untagged and stripped referrers, so it absorbs most app and email traffic.

platform_action_use_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns offering each streaming or chat platform action, by organizer country.

platform_action_use_by_industry.definition: Share of campaigns offering each streaming or chat platform action, by organizer industry.

entry_restriction_by_country.definition: Share of campaigns restricting who may enter by location, by organizer country, and how those campaigns compare on size.

invalid_entry_share_by_country_excluding.definition: The same invalid entry rate by organizer country, with labelled crypto and SaaS organizers removed, to show how much of a country's rate is its industry mix rather than the country. Only labelled campaigns are in scope, so the n is much smaller.

mechanics_by_country_excluding_crypto.definition: Run length, mandatory actions, question actions and top action worth by organizer country with labelled crypto and SaaS organizers removed, so the country differences can be read against a comparable set of consumer brands.

industry_mix_by_country.definition: Share of a country's labelled campaigns falling in each industry, groups of at least 30 campaigns and 5 organizers only, so the shares within a country do not sum to one.
